Noah (Finance): Heads up — partner 'AtlasChannel' disputed an Apr invoice line. They say AWS applied a proration differently than our contract, resulting in a $1,275 overcharge. They want a corrective credit before their EOM payment.
Hannah (Billing Ops): Can you paste the invoice snippet? I'll check our proration logic and the AWS settlement file.
Noah (Finance): Snippet: 
```
invoice_id,sku,period,qty,unit_price,ext_amount
INV-90021,ML-API-UNIT,2026-04-01 to 2026-04-15,15000,0.05,750.00
INV-90021,ML-API-UNIT,2026-04-16 to 2026-04-30,15000,0.045,675.00
TOTAL,, ,30000, ,1425.00
```
Partner expected a blended rate per contract which would yield $150 less (total $1,275).
Ravi (Partner Success): Partner sent contract excerpt showing blended rate calc. They asked to apply a corrective credit on May invoice.
aws-marketplace-bot: Notice: AWS settlement shows two separate billing intervals for atlas-channel on 2026-04-15 and 2026-04-30. Case opened: 03-801234.
Priya (Accounting): For <$2k we can issue internal credit memo pending AWS confirmation. Book to contra-revenue 4240 and include memo 'proration dispute - pending AWS case 03-801234'. No manager approval needed.
Hannah (Billing Ops): I'll re-run proration script with blended rate and produce adjusted invoice PDF. Uploading to FIN-3367.
Noah (Finance): Approved to apply provisional credit $150 to be reflected on May invoice. Please get partner ack and attach AWS case.
Ravi (Partner Success): Sent partner confirmation: "We'll apply $150 credit to your May invoice while we confirm with AWS. We'll reverse if AWS resolves differently." Partner replied: "Thanks, that works."
Priya (Accounting): Logged provisional credit and created reversing journal template.
Noah (Finance): Added 7-business-day reminder to FIN-3367. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
